'''Jariah Syn's blaster''' was a [[sporting blaster carbine]]<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> used by [[Jariah Syn]] around [[137 ABY]]. It was referred to as a "cannon" by [[Deliah Blue]], likely due to its large size.
